title: Istanbul Ottoman Heritage & Arts Trip
summary: A 2-day cultural journey for a couple in their 30s who love Orhan Pamuk, Sami Yusuf, Ottoman history, calligraphy, coffee and sweets. The itinerary blends historic landmarks, museums, and authentic halal dining in Sultanahmet and Beyoğlu, with prayer stops at nearby mosques.
tips: Purchase an Istanbulkart for easy public transport access.
Dress modestly when visiting mosques; women should carry a scarf.
Try Turkish coffee and baklava at local cafés for an authentic taste.
